name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods that change how Claude Code works and what it shows: hooks on prompts and tool calls, bands above the prompt, slash commands

plugins.name: deviation-kernel
plugins.description: Holds a project's refused assumptions in Claude's system prompt, flags edits and answers that re-impose them, and pauses on the step where it happens

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Shows above the prompt how warm the prompt cache is, what a cache miss would cost to rewrite, context fill, and the session's API-rate cost

plugins.name: goal-board
plugins.description: Each session's goal, task progress and ETA above the prompt, and a /goals board of every running session on this machine
